items: cnl-1 URL invariant enforced on ViewDefinition.url: rejects |, #, and space (regex ^[^|# ]+$)
cnl-1 strictness applies to canonical URL fields (url) but NOT to Column.type — spec accepts relative URIs and element-ID references there (e.g. 'Observation.referenceRange', 'relative/path')
profile[] and meta.profile[] use FHIR canonical form: |version suffix permitted (canonical type semantics, distinct from cnl-1)
cnl-0 name warning: ViewDefinition.name must start with capital letter and be 2-255 chars total; warning severity per spec (do not promote to error)
sql-name invariant ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ enforced at parser/dataclass/serializer boundaries on name, column.name, constant.name, relatedArtifact.label
CanonicalResource/DomainResource roundtrip via extra_fields dict preserves unknown top-level keys verbatim through from_dict/to_dict (no validation, no coercion)
DomainResource text.div narrative round-trips byte-for-byte at the JSON level
column.tag.name namespace recommendation surfaces as warning when name lacks a '/' prefix (spec 'recommended', not 'shall')
extra_fields has repr=False, compare=False so dataclass repr/equality semantics are unaffected
chunks.notes: 3/3 personalities clean (30 fresh cases). cnl-1 WARNING severity on url (space=lexical error); Column.type exempt; same-vs-cross resource element-ID doctrine; canonical |version forms; cnl-0 name WARNING; sql-name all boundaries; extra_fields repr/compare isolation + verbatim retention; text.div byte round-trip; tag.name namespace warning.

items: Library.meta.profile dispatches between SQLQuery (https://sql-on-fhir.org/ig/StructureDefinition/SQLQuery) and SQLView (https://sql-on-fhir.org/StructureDefinition/SQLView); both declared = rejected as ambiguous
content 1..* cardinality enforced; each entry has contentType (non-empty string) and data (base64-encoded UTF-8 SQL)
sql-must-be-sql-expressions invariant: every content[].contentType starts with 'application/sql'
relatedArtifact entries: type='depends-on', label satisfies sql-name ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, resource is non-empty canonical
SQLView forbids parameter (cardinality 0..0); SQLQuery allows 1..* with name (non-empty), type (FHIR primitive), use='in'
Rejection paths: missing profile, wrong profile, missing content, bad base64, wrong type coding — all raise typed SQLQueryParseError
extra_fields bag preserves unknown Library keys verbatim through parse_library / to_dict roundtrip
Public API: parse_library, parse_sqlquery (strict), parse_sqlview (strict) return typed SQLQuery or SQLView dataclass
chunks.notes: 3/3 personalities clean (24 fresh cases). Profile dispatch (dual canonical forms, |version, ambiguous/no-profile rejections); LibraryTypesCodes type binding; content cardinals + base64-UTF-8; application/sql prefix invariant; round-trip + extra-field retention.

items: Each relatedArtifact materializes as CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "<label>" AS <generated SQL>; label quoted via viewdef.utils.quote_identifier
ViewDefinition dependencies generate SQL via viewdef.SQLGenerator(source_table=...) and become DuckDB views
SQLView dependencies recurse: materialize their own relatedArtifact first, then CREATE VIEW from their content.data SQL body
Dependency cycle detection (set of canonicals currently being resolved) raises SQLQueryCycleError before DuckDB execution
Content selection prefers 'application/sql;dialect=duckdb', falls back to 'application/sql', rejects other dialects with UnsupportedDialectError
Parameter binding via DuckDB prepared statements — no string interpolation of caller-supplied values anywhere on the parameter path

FHIR-type → DuckDB-type coercion via dict-driven registry in viewdef.types._FHIR_TYPE_TO_DUCKDB (string→VARCHAR, integer→INTEGER, decimal→DOUBLE, boolean→BOOLEAN, date→DATE, dateTime→TIMESTAMP, time→TIME, etc.)
Missing required parameter raises SQLQueryTypeError with parameter name context
Wrong-type parameter (e.g., string for declared boolean/integer/decimal) raises SQLQueryTypeError with declared vs. got detail
Unsupported FHIR type (e.g., CodeableConcept, Quantity, Period — complex types not in the MVP registry) raises SQLQueryTypeError
Idempotent re-execution: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW does not error on existing view; callers may DROP VIEW to release names
chunks.notes: 3/3 personalities clean (21 fresh cases). Materialization chains (1-level, 2-level, diamond, self/mutual cycles -> SQLQueryCycleError pre-execution); dialect selection; :name prepared-statement binding w/ FHIR-type coercion (string/integer/decimal/boolean/date); missing/wrong-type/complex-type param rejections; idempotent re-run; label sql-name invariant; resolver accepts VD dicts + Library dicts.

items: One-level chain: SQLQuery with one relatedArtifact pointing at a ViewDefinition canonical — materializes VD as view, raw SQL body resolves alias correctly
Two-level chain: SQLQuery → SQLView → ViewDefinition — recursive materialization produces correct rows
Cycle: SQLView A depends on SQLView B depends on SQLView A — SQLQueryCycleError raised before execution
Resolver contract: ViewDefinition dict detected structurally (has 'select' + 'resource' keys, since ViewDefinition has no FHIR resourceType the way Library does)
Resolver contract: Library dict detected by resourceType='Library'; parsed ViewDefinition/SQLQuery/SQLView objects handled via isinstance
Resolver failure (any exception) translated to SQLQueryMaterializationError with label + canonical context
Identifier quoting: relatedArtifact.label and parameter.name validated against sql-name and quoted via viewdef.utils.quote_identifier before reaching DuckDB
Error model integration: SQLError inherits from viewdef.errors.SQLOnFHIRError (BUGFIX-001); except SQLOnFHIRError catches all SQLQuery errors transitively
All SQLQuery errors also inherit from ValueError (via SQLOnFHIRError) for backward-compat with callers catching the broad parent
One-way dependency: fhir4ds/viewdef/ never imports fhir4ds/sqlquery/ (verified by grep)
Public API surface: parse_library, parse_sqlquery, parse_sqlview, validate_sql_library, select_best_content, SQLQueryRunner, DependencyResolver type alias
chunks.notes: 3/3 personalities clean (22 fresh checks). 1/2/3-level chains; cycles pre-execution; resolver contract (VD dicts/objects, Library dicts/objects, ambiguous rejection); innermost-failure context; error hierarchy (SQLError<-SQLOnFHIRError<-ValueError); sql-name quoting; one-way dependency; full public API surface.
